d.subject: Final handoff: Alpha3 same-source precise temporal monotonicity
d.finding: Current main orders precise samples by sample sequence but does not fence observedUptimeMs monotonicity. A later accepted SAMSUNG_PRECISE sequence can carry an older observed time, move preciseValidUntil backward, and feed regressing time into continuity.
d.sourceMechanism: AngleReader derives sourceUptime from logcat wall-clock epoch via System.currentTimeMillis -> SystemClock.uptimeMillis conversion; sample order is assigned independently by Fold7AnglePipelineGen2.
d.recommendedInvariant: Same-source later precise sequence must not regress semantic time or the active lease deadline; retain raw source time for evidence, expose anomaly, and do not let anomalous samples extend the lease indefinitely.
d.nextDeviceEvidence: During Fold7 Alpha3 field test, record precise sequence delta, raw sourceUptime delta, received age and resulting lease deadline. Any accepted seqDelta>0 with sourceDelta<0 confirms physical reachability.

en: Final R&D handoff: current Alpha3 has a confirmed same-source time/order contract gap. A later accepted Samsung precise sample can carry an older derived source time and shorten the precise lease to near-immediate expiry. Three deterministic harnesses passed 37/37 checks. Physical Fold7 occurrence is not claimed. Main stayed at 98a7c1c; no production GitHub writes were made.
